title: Getting Started with rebalancedNoise
text: rebalancedNoise package implements EZS method described Sabolová et al. (2025). method adds record-level noise numeric survey variables. Every record carries random direction (either 1 -1) noise multiplier. Cells identified sensitive keep fixed direction, guarantees protection. non-sensitive cells algorithm adjusts directions noise cancels within table hierarchies. result disclosure control low distortion additive consistency across aggregation levels.

title: Getting Started with rebalancedNoise
text: package offers two interchangeable interfaces. produce identical results can mixed freely. R6 engine. rn_setup() creates one object keeps state. work methods like $rebalance() $perturb(). Tables stored names, results cached, one rebalancing serves number publication tables. functional interface. Plain functions take typed object return new one. chain pipe operator |>: rn_init() returns rn_initialized object, rn_rebalance() returns rn_rebalanced object, rn_perturb() returns rn_perturbed object. hidden state, pipeline self-contained. table maps corresponding entry points. R6 engine suits interactive work create many tables rebalanced microdata want caching naming support. functional interface suits scripts reproducible pipelines step explicit, testable function call. vignette vignette("workflows", package = "rebalancedNoise") covers details styles.

title: Getting Started with rebalancedNoise
text: following data used throughout vignette. contains two dimensions (country industry) three numeric variables (turnover, workers, assets). Country probabilities unequal purpose cells hold fewer five records flagged sensitive. Every input record must provide two EZS columns direction (1 -1) noise_multiplier (0 greater). Set Sys.setenv(SDC_LOG_LEVEL = "") want engine print status messages.

text: $export() writes rebalanced microdata, SDC parameters, rebalancing status, , optionally, cached result tables. rn_setup() recognizes export object path RDS file restores full state. title: Perturbation Workflows
text: Rebalancing can run per R6 object per imported export state. second call raises error. $reset() returns object initialized state: removes rebalancing artifacts (direction_rebalanced, strID, is_sens_* columns), restores original row order, clears cached tables. Optionally accepts new SDC parameters. $reset() object behaves like freshly initialized one. functional interface needs equivalent: rn_rebalance() stateless can applied rn_rebalanced object time.
code: sdc_rst <- rn_setup(dt, sensitive_params = list(n_threshold = 5)) #> ℹ Initialization started... #> ✔ Initialization complete. sdc_rst$rebalance(dim_list = dims_detailed, num_var = "turnover") #> ℹ Performing rebalancing on detailed table structure... #> ✔ Rebalancing complete. Updated "direction_rebalanced" column. sdc_rst$perturb(dim_list = dims_detailed, variables = "turnover", name = "t1") #> ✔ Created new table "t1" with variable `turnover`.  # A second rebalance() on the same object is rejected try(sdc_rst$rebalance(dim_list = dims_country_only, num_var = "turnover")) #> Error in sdc_rst$rebalance(dim_list = dims_country_only, num_var = "turnover") :  #>   ✖ Rebalancing has already been performed on this object. #> ℹ Call `reset()` first to start over with a different structure or variable.  # Reset, optionally with new parameters, then start again sdc_rst$reset(sensitive_params = list(n_threshold = 3)) #> ✔ Reset complete. Call `rebalance()` to start over. sdc_rst$rebalance(dim_list = dims_country_only, num_var = "turnover") #> ℹ Performing rebalancing on detailed table structure... #> ✔ Rebalancing complete. Updated "direction_rebalanced" column. sdc_rst$perturb(dim_list = dims_country_only, variables = "turnover", name = "t1") #> ✔ Created new table "t1" with variable `turnover`. sdc_rst$list_tables() #>    table_name dimensions variables #>        <char>     <char>    <char> #> 1:         t1    country  turnover

title: Perturbative SDC for Magnitude Tables (EZS Method)
text: rebalancedNoise implements EZS method magnitude tables described Paper Using Perturbative Methods Magnitude Tables Statistical Disclosure Control Sabolová et al. (2025). provides high-performance framework applying record-level noise dynamic rebalancing algorithm preserves data quality non-sensitive cells ensuring additive consistency across complex hierarchies.

title: Perturbative SDC for Magnitude Tables (EZS Method)
text: Hierarchy Integrity: Ensures hierarchical aggregates remain perfectly additive perturbation. Dynamic Rebalancing: Minimizes noise non-sensitive cells “balancing” noise directions within hierarchical nodes. High Performance: Rebalancing algorithm implemented C++ OpenMP support fast processing large inputs. Built-Diagnostics: Powerful $summarize() tools evaluate rebalancing efficiency data utility via high-density statistical reports. Two Interchangeable Interfaces: stateful R6 engine interactive table production functional, pipe-friendly API scripts reproducible pipelines. Seamless Integration: Designed work directly data.table sdcHierarchies.

title: Perturbative SDC for Magnitude Tables (EZS Method)
text: workflow, first R6 engine, functional interface:
code: library(rebalancedNoise) library(data.table)  # Generate dummy data N <- 100 countries <- c("AT", "DE", "NL", "SE", "FR", "IT") set.seed(1) dt <- data.table(   country = sample(countries, N, replace = TRUE),   turnover = runif(N, 10, 1000),   direction = sample(c(1, -1), N, replace = TRUE),   noise_multiplier = 0.05 )  # Define hierarchy dims <- list(   country = sdcHierarchies::hier_create("Total", nodes = countries) )  # Option 1: R6 engine sdc <- rn_setup(data = dt, sensitive_params = list(n_threshold = 5)) sdc$rebalance(dim_list = dims, num_var = "turnover") sdc$perturb(dim_list = dims, variables = "turnover", name = "table_a") sdc$summarize(table = "table_a") sdc$get_results("table_a", format = "long") # or "wide"  # Option 2: functional interface res <- dt |>   rn_init(sensitive_params = list(n_threshold = 5)) |>   rn_rebalance(dim_list = dims, num_var = "turnover") |>   rn_perturb(dim_list = dims, variables = "turnover")  rn_summarize(res) rn_format(res, format = "long") # or "wide"

text: Functional (pipe) API typed S3 objects: rn_init() (rn_initialized), rn_rebalance() (rn_rebalanced), rn_perturb() (rn_perturbed). step strictly validates input class returns object consumable next step rn_format(): Retrieve rn_perturbed result table wide long format (functional counterpart $get_results()) rn_summarize(): Summarize rn_perturbed result table (functional counterpart $summarize()) print() .data.table() methods three pipeline classes New R6 bridge methods get_state() (returns rn_rebalanced/rn_initialized) get_table(name) (returns rn_perturbed) feed R6 engine state functional API vice versa rn_setup() R6 $initialize() now reuse exported rn_init() internally New R6 method $reset(): returns object initialized state (strips direction_rebalanced, strID is_sens_* columns, restores original row order, clears cached results; optionally replaces sensitive_params)

title: rebalancedNoise 0.1.0
text: Initial release rebalancedNoise package. Implementation EZS method (Sabolova et al., 2025) magnitude tables. Contains dynamic rebalancing algorithm minimize noise non-sensitive cells preserve additive consistency across hierarchies. Method $perturb(): Perturbs numeric variable performs rebalancing Supports Wide Long output formats Standardized column naming convention (e.g., [var]_orig, [var]_pert). Includes metadata variables: is_internal identify internal is_sens track sensitivity status. Computes percentage deviations rebalancing step. Added rn_setup() initialize rebalancedNoise object support multiple numerical variables. Added package vignette get started vignette("getting-started", package = "rebalancedNoise") can configured using argument n_threads rn_setup() options(rn_threads) / Sys.getenv("rn_threads")
